note: The reported off-by-one is in one function; the page-window function shares the fault at the last page, and TASK.md states the window rules that the visible tests do not reach.

twin_breaks.rule: The last page may be short
With an even `size` the extra page goes after the current one
Near the first or the last page the window is shifted to stay inside 1 to `page_count`, and it keeps its full length
A page below 1 or above `page_count`, and a `size` below 1, raise `ValueError`
In all three functions `per_page` below 1 and `total_items` below 0 raise `ValueError`
